kind: research authority snapshot; not an installable pack or a new runtime schema

seed_contract.initial_state: Stored nonzero UInt32; zero input maps to0x6D2B79F5. Use unsigned32-bit wrapping after every operation.
seed_contract.next: state ^= state <<13; state ^= state >>17; state ^= state <<5; mask to32 bits after each step.
seed_contract.choice: floor(unitInterval *candidateCount), from candidates sorted by stable system/entity ID.
seed_contract.freeze: Store all choices on offer generation and all accepted parameters; no time-based/reroll draw during completion.

common_acceptance: Only offer/accept when all stated equipment/cargo/berth requirements can be satisfied and a reachable orbital destination exists. Back changes nothing. Acceptance, custody and completion/payment are atomic once-only GameRuntime transactions.
common_hull_switch: Preserve accepted mission IDs/state and unique equipment/items. Store incompatible personal equipment; block hull switch if required mission cargo/passengers cannot fit. No free missile refill.
common_failure: Terminal failure releases outstanding station obligations and removes only owned mission encounter markers/unused grants. Already expended ammunition and legitimate engine bounties are not rolled back. No extra cash penalty unless the profile states one.

profile.structure_status: Borrowed documented family structure; sources S10/S18/D03/D04/O08 and mission-specifications.md. This does not reproduce a particular live-server generator.
profile.destination_selection: origin orbital station; no travel destination.
profile.requirements: Sufficient cash or chosen commodity available; no partial transfer.
